set.body:
One coding effort covers preview narrative/referent scenes, DL1 atoms/kinds/addresses, DL3 graded fidelity, DL4 evidence-based coverage, DL6 participant/action/occurrence, and graph-family/readout claims selected for the joint study. Use a coding sheet based on source/recall inputs with model predictions hidden; retain independent disagreements before adjudication. Owner calibration items and all timing-pilot material are seen/throwaway, not fresh tests.
Engineering acceptance: one reviewed rubric and timing-pilot report records minutes per unit/atom/family, exposure handling and a coding budget proposal. Prepare alongside implementation; no wait for fresh results. Recruitment/data access still require existing owner approvals. Actual frozen study remains in the human protocol/material/execution lane; do not relabel the synthetic recovery court as human accuracy.
set.title: [detail-mapping] Joint blind coding rubric and timing pilot (preview, detail and graph)
